fields.v: Exploratory study, 6 participants (Table V, VII). Authors' criterion: AI-Dev Index quality zones (Zone 1 Insufficient < 40 ... Zone 4 Autonomous Agent >= 85); Rrev target < 1. Claude Web + Claude Sonnet 4.6 (baseline): A1 0.01, A2 23.8, A3 25.0, A4 60.0, Itotal 24.32 (Zone 1); Tc 42.8 min, If 80.1, Rrev 0.87 — quality verdict: does not work (Zone 1); cost verdict: no criterion stated by the authors. GitHub Copilot (VS Code) + Claude Sonnet 4.6: A1 70.87, A2 71.4, A3 75.0, A4 72.0, Itotal 72.62 (Zone 3); Tc 22.3 min, If 7.2, Rrev 0.42 — quality verdict: partly (Zone 3, requires supervision); cost verdict: no criterion stated by the authors. Google Antigravity + Claude Sonnet 4.6: A1 100.0, A2 95.2, A3 100.0, A4 96.0, Itotal 98.48 (Zone 4); Tc 10.6 min, If 4.5, Rrev 0.15; overall subjective 9.8/10 — quality verdict: works (Zone 4); cost verdict: no criterion stated by the authors. Secondary phase (Table VIII): Antigravity + Gemini 3 Flash: A1 87.84, Itotal 94.83 (Zone 4), Tc 8.5 min, more prompts and higher Rrev — quality verdict: works (Zone 4); Antigravity + Claude Sonnet 4.6: A1 98.47, Itotal 98.02, Tc 10.6 min — works (Zone 4); cost verdicts: no criterion stated by the authors

fields.v: One project, 3 scenarios of escalating complexity; 3 tools with the model fixed to Claude Sonnet 4.6 (to isolate the tool's contribution); baseline Claude Web; 6 participants of three seniority levels in a counterbalanced Latin-square design (each participant uses each tool once, on a different scenario); secondary phase swaps the model (Gemini 3 Flash vs Claude Sonnet 4.6) in Antigravity, participants not stated. No acceptance tests. One session per participant-scenario. Human intervention: humans operate the tools interactively; sessions recorded

fields.v: Antigravity > Copilot > Claude Web on every axis (Itotal 98.48 / 72.62 / 24.32); Tc 10.6 / 22.3 / 42.8 min (SD ±1.5 / ±3.2 / ±6.4), If 4.5 / 7.2 / 80.1, Rrev 0.15 / 0.42 / 0.87; ordering preserved for every participant and under four weighting schemes (Table VI). Model swap changed only A1 (Gemini faster but more prompts and higher Rrev; index 94.83 vs 98.02, both Zone 4). Index aligned with subjective satisfaction (> 90%, Fig. 3). No statistical significance tests

fields.v: Distinguished the three tools consistently (per participant and across weightings); repeatability not assessed beyond per-participant ordering. Limitations: N = 6 exploratory; seniority effects only qualitative; single full-stack web project; task-complexity bias (simpler tasks may narrow gaps). Not stated by the authors: min-max normalisation makes the index relative to the tools compared, and the 'validation' uses the same participants' overall score
